           → Reduce include, a, mx, ptr, exists and redirect terms: replace stable hosts with
             ip4/ip6 ranges and remove unused includes. Receivers return permerror once the limit is
             exceeded.
  LOW      MAIL-DMARC-008  DMARC aggregate reports are not requested
           lookups.example: The DMARC record does not request aggregate reports (rua).
           │ v=DMARC1; p=reject
           → Add rua=mailto:... to receive aggregate reports; without them you cannot see who sends
             mail using the domain.
  LOW      MAIL-MTASTS-001  MTA-STS not deployed
           lookups.example does not publish MTA-STS; senders may deliver mail over unauthenticated
           or plaintext connections.
           → Publish an MTA-STS policy (start with mode: testing and TLS-RPT) so that senders
             require authenticated TLS when delivering to your MX hosts.
  LOW      MAIL-MX-002  Domain publishes neither MX nor address records
           lookups.example: The domain has no MX records and no A/AAAA records, so it cannot receive
           mail, but senders are not told so explicitly.
           → If the domain does not receive mail, publish a null MX record ("0 .") so senders fail
             fast instead of retrying.
  INFO     MAIL-DKIM-001  DKIM audit incomplete: no selector specified
           lookups.example: DKIM keys are published under selector names that cannot be enumerated
           from DNS. Pass --dkim-selector to audit specific keys, or analyse a signed message to
           discover the selectors in use.
  INFO     MAIL-TLSRPT-001  TLS-RPT not configured
           lookups.example does not request SMTP TLS reports, so TLS delivery failures to its MX
           hosts go unnoticed.
